$comment: Names and ids only, never a secret. The crew addresses Airtable by NAME and
resolves each name to your base's ids at startup, so a duplicated base needs
only a new airtable.baseId. Change a name only if your base renames the field.

figma.$note: Only tokens is required. One Figma file? set tokens, leave components blank. Components are read per-row from Airtable, so add component files only if you want them named here.

stack.$note: Set at /setup. Decides the component code AND the token output. Regenerates tools.md.

repo.$note: Branch names are yours. Defaults below. If your repo already uses develop/master or another flow, /setup detects it and maps the three tiers (work → preview → production) to your branches. If you rename these, also update the branch refs in .github/workflows/pages.yml.

deploy.$note: true = full pipeline (DevOps + CI deploy to Pages, QA tests the live staging URL). false = no DevOps, no CI; QA tests the local Storybook and the lifecycle ends at Passed.
